{{Quote|I honestly don't know whether to laugh or shed a tear. Here I've been thinking of you as a talented smuggler and able mercenary, and now I learn that you're more a sentimental chaperone.|Wilhuff Tarkin|<ref name="Catalyst" />}}
'''Has Obitt''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Dressellian]] who was a [[smuggler]] active during the reigns of both the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]]. Obitt became a pawn of [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] in his schemes for power. During Orson's initial scheme, Obitt was tasked with [[Vallt Rescue Operation|rescuing]] [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen]], [[Lyra Erso|Lyra]], and [[Jyn Erso]] from their [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] captors on the [[planet]] [[Vallt]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], Obitt traveled with Lyra to [[Alpinn]] searching for [[kyber crystal]]s. Obitt was involved in a [[Salient Campaign|rebellion]] in the [[Salient system]], along with [[Saw Gerrera]] and was captured at [[Salient II]] by [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. During his capture, he arranged a deal with Tarkin to allow him to regain his freedom in exchange for getting back in Krennic's good graces and spying on Krennic for Tarkin. Has, however, secretly arranged for [[Saw Gerrera]] to help the [[Erso family]] escape from Coruscant.<ref name="Catalyst" />

Jyn Erso later had a toy doll named "[[Lucky Hazz Obloobitt]]."<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I needed another foil for Krennic, someone who he could bring into the mix that would become important to the ultimate plot of the book. Krennic is trying to manipulate Galen but is also trying to manipulate Wilhuff Tarkin. Obitt will end up playing an important part in Krennic's schemes to get his way and increase his personal power base, in part by getting everyone else into trouble.|James Luceno|<ref name="Crafting Catalyst">{{SW|url=news/crafting-catalyst-james-luceno-discusses-his-rogue-one-prequel-novel-interview|text=Crafting ''Catalyst'': James Luceno Discusses His ''Rogue One'' Prequel Novel}}</ref>}}
Has Obitt first appeared in the [[2016]] [[canon]] novel ''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]]. The novel served as a prequel to the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Catalyst" /> Luceno created the character because the story required an additional foil for Krennic, someone Krennic could bring into the mix who would become important to the ultimate plot.<ref name="Crafting Catalyst" />
